kata — keybindings

Global                             Detail                                     Forms
?         help                     tab            next tab                    ctrl+o         save or apply
q/ctrl+c  quit                     shift+tab      prev tab                    esc            cancel
P         projects                 enter          jump to referenced issue    tab/shift+tab  change field
D         daemons                  esc/backspace  back                        ctrl+e         open editor
F         federation               e              edit body                   ctrl+u         clear prompt
C         credentials              c              new comment
L         toggle layout            p              set parent                  Filters
                                   b              add blocker                 /       search
Graph                              l              add related                 s       cycle status filter
k       up                         +              add label                   f       filter (form)
j       down                       -              remove label                c       clear filters
up      scroll up                  a              assign owner                ctrl+r  reset filter form
down    scroll down                A              clear owner
pgup    page up                    t              timed assignment
pgdown  page down                  !              set priority
g       first
G       last                       Children
enter   open detail                N      new child
space   expand/collapse            j/k    move child cursor
right   expand                     ↑↓     scroll detail viewport
left    collapse                   enter  open child
E       expand/collapse all
n       new issue (form)
v       toggle flat/nested view
o       toggle graph order
x       close
r       reopen

press ? to return
